analyst.summary: Minda Corporation is a diversified auto-components maker (wiring harnesses, vehicle access, die-casting, instrument clusters) posting strong growth — FY26 revenue up 22%, profit up 40%, and a new record quarter in Q1 FY27 — plus a new joint venture with Toyo Denso for automotive switches. Return on equity (8.4%) has not yet caught up to the growth story or to the fairly rich ~45x valuation. We rate it a Hold.
